name: Planisphere
desc: A printed planispheric star chart in stereographic projection — a circular celestial map ruled with radial hour circles and concentric declination rings, the ecliptic swinging across as an offset gold circle studded with zodiac marks, the galactic plane stippled as a soft Milky Way band, magnitude-scaled stars plotted and twinkling, an hour-lettered rim and cartouche, the whole plate slowly turning with the sidereal sky.
